files.code:
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity

def build_prompt(examples, query):
    # prompt few-shot: ví dụ mẫu rồi câu hỏi mới
    parts = [f"Q: {q}\nA: {a}" for q, a in examples]
    return "\n\n".join(parts) + f"\n\nQ: {query}\nA:"

print(build_prompt([("2+2", "4")], "3+5"))

chunks = ["The Eiffel Tower is in Paris.",
          "It was built in 1889 by Gustave Eiffel.",
          "The Colosseum is in Rome and was completed in 80 AD."]

def retrieve(query, chunks):
    vec = TfidfVectorizer(stop_words="english").fit(chunks + [query])
    sims = cosine_similarity(vec.transform([query]), vec.transform(chunks))[0]
    return int(sims.argmax())

idx = retrieve("when was the Colosseum completed", chunks)
print(idx, chunks[idx])
